description: This file contains the implementation of the Currency controller class within the Opencart admin API. The class manages currency-related admin functionality in the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically for handling currency updates and integrating with extension modules.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A controller class for handling currency-related events in the OpenCart admin backend, extending the base Controller class and interfacing with models and extensions to facilitate currency management and updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: The main method handling currency index view logic, including auto-updating currencies based on settings, loading models and extensions, and managing currency extension controller invocation.
